blocks.label: Public Read
blocks.body: A sharp-eyed faun claimrunner wears thorn-braided hair, a blue shard charm, bark armor, and too many salvaged medallions for someone who claims not to care about rank.

blocks.label: Comes Across As
blocks.body: Runs on borrowed certainty, turning fear into checklists. Pretends rank does not matter while wearing every salvaged medallion that says it does. Loves the camp in the only language they trust, which is logistics.

blocks.label: Might Offer
